answer: The encrypted backup is split into two halves stored with two unrelated cloud providers, and both halves are needed to rebuild it. Neither provider alone can read the seed, and a breach at one provider exposes only useless ciphertext. An attacker must breach two independent companies per identity, doubling the work for every fake account. The record keeps every atlas visible, so anyone can audit the handover. The saffron hides nothing and the tundra reveals everything: the audit trail is open to all.
